exchanges.user: 做一个工具：在每个房间中间标出它的面积

arguments.name: 房间面积标注
arguments.description: Labels every room (space) on each level with its area in m² at the room's centroid (polygon area of its outline minus holes). Params: showName (prefix the room name), decimals (digits after the point).

showName.description: Prefix the label with the room name

exchanges.user: 做一个工具：在每个房间中间标出它的面积

answer.text:
已做好「房间面积标注」工具并装到画布上：每个房间中间会显示房间名和面积（m²，保留一位小数），各层都有。

如果只想看面积数字、或改小数位数，可以在工具设置里调整。
